coordinates: one StandardScaler fit on source TRAIN_GEOMETRY session-1 embeddings only within each CV fit; identical transform applied to h and r; no subject-specific scaler
bilinear_fit: TRAIN-label-supervised class-difference cross-moment SVD supplies K u/v pairs; deterministic L2 balanced logistic fits additive h/r and K product scores. No full unconstrained 64x64 matrix or neural backbone update.
B_selection: 5-fold subject-grouped TRAIN pseudo-target S2 CV; equal-weight mean BA of TRIAL_ONLY, RELATIVE_SUBTRACTION, ADDITIVE_CONTEXT, ELEMENTWISE_INTERACTION at fixed C=0.1; smallest B tie break
linear_selection: At frozen B, equal 5-C grid and 5-fold subject-grouped TRAIN pseudo-target S2 CV for every linear arm; choose highest subject-equal BA, smallest C tie break
bilinear_selection: At frozen B, evaluate each K and C by the same 5-fold subject-grouped TRAIN pseudo-target S2 CV as linear arms. Choose highest subject-equal BA, then smallest K and C. This is model selection, not an unbiased TRAIN performance estimate.
family_selection: Highest 5-fold TRAIN subject-equal CV BA among four noninteraction arms and separately E/F/lowrank; fixed listed-order tie break. No OUTER selection.
random_capacity: 100 deterministic TRAIN-fitted random linear expansions per interaction family, dimension matched to that family and no h-r multiplicative term; selected TRAIN C fixed. One H-only linear expansion matched to selected interaction dimension.
train_pairing_scope: First of five grouped TRAIN pseudo-target folds; permute context references across source TRAIN subjects before fitting; evaluate identical held TRAIN S2 subjects with true context
class_balance_diagnostic: Use labels only to form a balanced subset within the already frozen first-B context, never for deployed context or model selection
metric: subject-equal balanced accuracy; macro-F1 and NLL secondary

gates.A: BEST_INTERACTION-BEST_NONINTERACTION mean >=0.010, positive >=4/5 folds, subject-bootstrap lower95>0
gates.D: selected interaction beats parameter-matched random expansion and H-only expansion in pooled BA
gates.E: current context not worse than historical; strong >=0.005

prohibited: causal or biological interpretation of bilinear dimensions
